name: Depth Consistency
algorithm: Depth Consistency — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes depth consistency across video frames for deepfake and manipulation detection:

1. **Monocular深度推定**: Per-frame relative depth maps are estimated using monocular depth cues: texture gradients, defocus, atmospheric perspective, relative size, and occlusion relationships. Each pixel receives a relative depth value consistent with the scene geometry.

2. **時間的深度安定性**: Depth maps across consecutive frames should show smooth, physically motivated changes. The method tracks depth map evolution — natural scene depth changes are caused by camera motion (smooth, globally coherent) or object motion (local, bounded). Deepfakes may produce temporally unstable depth maps, especially at face-swap boundaries where generated face depth differs from the original face geometry.

3. **顔-Scene深度統合**: The depth relationship between the face and surrounding scene must be consistent. The method checks: (a) face depth varies correctly with camera distance, (b) face depth matches nearby objects at similar distances, (c) face depth changes are consistent with measured face scale changes. Composited deepfake faces may show depth inconsistencies with the scene.

4. **深度-Defocus一貫性**: Estimated depth should correlate with defocus blur — objects at similar depths should show similar focus. The method cross-validates depth estimates against local defocus measures. AI-generated faces may show incorrect depth-defocus relationships, appearing sharp at depths where the background is blurred (or vice versa).

5. **3D幾何学的一貫性スコアリング**: The implied 3D geometry is checked for physical plausibility. Face orientation (from landmarks) should produce consistent depth gradients. Perspective distortion should match the estimated camera parameters. Violations of geometric consistency indicate manipulation, yielding an elevated forensic score.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through depth consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
